apps.name: 音乐播放器
apps.description: 控制系统音乐播放，查看歌词与播放列表
apps.long_description:
1.1.10: 歌词长度/时间轴不对进无词模式，有词自动恢复。

1.1.9: 有歌词模式标题 -1px；歌曲信息 gap 5px。

1.1.8: 修复关侧栏/回无词时 hero 闪现（统一居中+max-width 过渡）。

1.1.7: 移动端 hero/安全区/Sheet 时序与横屏适配；平板侧栏比例。

1.1.6: 修复歌词 0 宽炸高与恢复延迟；收紧 hero 间距/加大字号；侧栏态内边距与动效打磨。

1.1.5: 侧栏开合/歌词列表切换动效；歌词与列表同占地。

1.1.4: 修复长标题溢出到歌词区。

1.1.3: 侧栏三态（无/歌词/列表）；去掉暂无歌词占位。

1.1.2: 去掉歌词加载动画；无词布局按 Tab 焦点切换。

1.1.1: Fab 通用浮动图标按钮（定位当前/动效/翻译）。

1.1.0: 无歌词模式——封面优先布局与精致空态。

1.0.10: 修复主题色边框渐变滞后。

1.0.9: 定位当前改为列表右下角浮动图标按钮。

1.0.8: 主题色切换渐变插值（@property）。

1.0.7: 识别宿主 hasThemePalette，占位色不覆盖上一首主题。

1.0.6: 切歌保留上一首主题色，不再闪默认/中性色。

1.0.5: 移除封面加载遮罩与 spinner。

1.0.4: 播放失败状态条；空列表引导；搜索无结果 i18n；[/] 快进退 5s；音量快捷键与滑条一致。

1.0.3: 曲目 generation 硬绑定防串态；缓冲/空态/状态条；封面 crossfade；键盘快捷键；默认面板持久化；定位当前曲；移动端左右滑切换歌词/列表。

1.0.2: 切歌时主题色及时同步（识别 primaryColor 变化）、封面高优先级解码、邻曲封面预取；Windows/触控布局与 Aurora 频谱更稳健。

对接系统播放器，显示封面、进度与播放控制；支持同步歌词、列表搜索，以及顺序、循环、单曲和随机模式。

apps.name: Aro
apps.description: 社交中心，统一管理消息、时间线、环网与个人资料
apps.long_description:
1.0.48: mobile text overflow hardening — bubbles, headers, feed cards, share/file names, long URLs wrap on narrow screens.

1.0.47: modular page split (msgUi/feedUi/mentionUi/roomUi/…), chat perf (windowing, optimistic send, scroll smart, feed load-more), room stickers/admin/@ mentions UI, setMemberRole.

1.0.39: click post for detail modal; list cards truncate with show more.

1.0.38: quote/repost full body + click to open original (no follow required).

1.0.37: E2E decrypt race fix + soft delivery banners.

1.0.36: inline composer icon styles for reinstall resilience.

1.0.35: fix emoji button gray plate.

1.0.34: full emoji picker + sticker packs complete.

社交中心：统一管理联邦消息（Channel/Room）、时间线、环网与个人资料。支持后台新消息通知、附件与多语言（中/英/日）。

1.0.33: room avatar + invite policy in edit/create.

1.0.32: sticker button click + panel polish.

1.0.31: fix store install missing page/stickers.js — stickers UI inlined into attachments.js (pageModules must stay in sync with index download.page_modules).

1.0.30: sticker entry + add stickers from chat images (group/personal packs).

1.0.29: composer sticker panel (group pack via host API; personal local).

1.0.28: lock composer during optimistic room open (no false active membership).

1.0.27: snappier view/chat/tab switching — no re-slide on A→B, same-chat no-op, shorter motion.

1.0.26: polish messenger UX — open skeleton, empty CTAs, busy buttons, send spinner, join toast.

1.0.25: debounce list refresh; remove unguarded member fallbacks.

1.0.24: proactive roster confirm burst after join/leave (0–6s retries + 2.5s poll boost).

1.0.23: room member roster refreshes on join/leave (WS + poll), live member_count, optimistic member_joined.

1.0.22: fix large inline chat images falling back to filename only (safeMessageImageUrl).

1.0.21: declare network:fetch so sandbox CSP allows remote https avatars/covers/federation media.

1.0.11: thin main (background-only), close pageModules file boundaries.

1.0.10: harden federation share rendering, safer store install and downloads.

1.0.9: centered Accept/Reject invite CTAs in chat body.

1.0.8: timeline share (X intent only), follow-graph mutual/domain badges.
